content: Long-horizon agent runs converge on a file-based append-only journal: deterministic orchestrator decides what runs and with what state, each LLM session is stateless/fresh, and durable state lives in files (tasks, journal, progress manifest) so any session can resume from the last checkpoint. Overlapping enforcement is assumed because any one layer (a hook edge case, a corrupted state file) can fail. Circuit breaker handles stuck detection and a max-session cap.
